text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from running 
errands with Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Please be careful. There appears to 
be a crowd over there――

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that looks so luxurious...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Whoops, *cough*.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, it seems there is no 
particular danger. Now then, continuing 
with bodyguard duty—
choice_data_list: Since we're here, why don't you draw one?
Since we're here, why not draw one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal tries to hide her interest in the 
raffle to stay knightly, so I decide to 
invite her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since the two of us came out shopping 
together, I wanted to give them a little 
breather.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...However, playing a lottery while on 
guard duty is unbecoming of a knight."
choice_data_list: Durandal. These are your orders, okay?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My lack of foresight brings me nothing but 
shame...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now that it has come to this, I shall 
deliver results worthy of offering to my 
liege!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clutching the lottery ticket she received 
while shopping, Durandal strides forward 
gallantly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheeks flushed with anticipation, I 
gripped the steering wheel. The result 
was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay~~!! Incredible, My Liege! It's the 
grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And as a pair, no less! Surely my 
liege's divine guidance has drawn this 
good fortune to us!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Or could it be—my morning knight's prayer 
actually worked? Wait, does that mean this 
is thanks to me!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I stuck with it~! Mornings are 
just... so sleepy, reeeally sleepy!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Wait.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it, Trainer-dono! What 
happened just now was, well, how should I 
put it...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...I got somewhat carried away by this 
rare victory. From here on, I shall brace 
myself and remain vigilant, so I beg your 
pardon.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please accept this, my Lord. 
This victory belongs to you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Huh!? No, you go ahead and use it!?
Huh!? No, you go ahead and use it!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No. That lottery ticket was originally 
obtained when you purchased my training 
equipment, Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, it is inevitable that this 
'Hot Springs Trip Voucher' shall belong to 
my Lord."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, whoever you choose to bring 
along, Trainer, I have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please bring along someone you deem worthy 
of the reward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, the only one I can 
think of who deserves appreciation is 
Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, right now is a crucial period for 
taking on the Twinkle Series. Inviting her 
out to hang out halfway through just 
wouldn't feel right.
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll hold onto this for you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Take care of it... you say?
choice_data_list: For when your hard work earns it.

For when your hard work proves worthy of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: You mean... together, someday...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!! Yes! I will make sure my work is 
worthy of this reward!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I agreed to hold onto the Hot 
Springs Trip Voucher she had won for a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: This is...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! With this size, it will surely 
satisfy our appetites!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I borrowed the cafeteria kitchen and 
whipped up some carrot hamburger steaks 
right away.
choice_data_list: Hold on, I'll slice it up now.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wait, my liege. I implore you, please 
entrust that crucial duty to me!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"For a knight, sharing a table with their 
King is the supreme joy."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
With all that joy and pride behind it, a 
single clean stroke! I'll show you that I 
can slice it right in two, carrot and all!
choice_data_list:
...No, you look like you're going to cut 
right through the plate.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: N-No way! Please let me do it, my liege~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The taste of the hamburger eaten amidst 
such a ruckus would remain etched in 
memory forever.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This is... a majestic sight, as if gazing 
upon Mount Badon itself!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!! Impressive, customer!! Be sure to 
build up your strength with these carrots!
choice_data_list: Still, it might be a bit too much...
Still, it might be a bit much, huh...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"If that is so, my Liege... Would you 
permit me to take care of it?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, there's something I've always 
dreamed of achieving one day!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Durandal had prepared was a barbecue 
featuring mountains of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Durandal-saaan!! Thank you sooo much for 
the invite!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me~! Hehe, I came here on an empty 
stomach♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Evidently, a lot of people were invited, 
as participants were arriving one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crunch, munch munch, crunch—)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Crunch, crunch, crunch, crunch... Carrots 
are best eaten while they're still hard 
and straight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, twelve Umamusume gathered 
together—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for gathering here today. 
This—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: To the banquet of the Round Table!
choice_data_list:
(I see, so this is what she wanted to 
do...)

(I see, so this is what she wanted to 
do...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As comrades running in the same era, I 
consider you all to be fellow knights, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crunch crunch crunch crunch...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Right O-san! It was just getting to 
the good part, so listen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as he spoke, the smile never faded 
from Durandal's face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the night of the delightful 
banquet passed by—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ngh... How pathetic of me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My liege, I am terribly sorry. I intended 
to offer you the greatest victory, yet all 
I have is a single carrot...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
However, there is no deceit in my fervent 
desire to serve the King.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I was only thinking of the King—
—Whaaaaat?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Girl Out Shopping
text_block_list.text: Are the carrots sold out...?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Grandma
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I just handed all of them over 
to be used as raffle prizes.

text_block_list.name: Girl Out Shopping
text_block_list.text:
No way……! But I really wanted to make 
curry for Mom and Dad……

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful for your words. 
However, coming to the aid of the weak is 
also the duty of a knight!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: And now—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Little princess. If you are in need, allow 
me to offer you this carrot.

text_block_list.name: Girl Out Shopping
text_block_list.text:
Whoa..., thank you, big sister! Here, I'll 
give you this in return!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Why, this brings me the utmost joy, my 
Princess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back, Durandal slowly and 
thoroughly savored the candy she had 
received from the young girl.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Kh... To think that I, of all people...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, my liege...! This is the 
blunder of a lifetime for Durandal...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The victory I was supposed to dedicate to 
my liege... The hot spring voucher...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Durandal slumped her shoulders in 
deep disappointment...
